checks: First opening remains locked before any network registration or Portal action
Four-digit registration preserves leading zeros and sends only the declared device metadata
A live restriction blocks new work immediately but acknowledges locking only after the active operation ends
An allowed policy restores use without replacing preferences or registering another installation
A minimum-version policy retains an accessible update path
Cross-tool replies cannot alter a stored policy or unlock this tool
Revoked credentials require re-enrollment and do not silently allow work
Heartbeats and persistent management state contain no patient, ward, query or settlement payload
